title: PHP
description: Server-side scripting with PHP — forms, sessions, PDO and modern practices.

chapters.title: PHP on the Server
objectives: Explain the core ideas behind PHP-FPM and echo.
Write and run working PHP code that uses PHP-FPM, echo, variables.
Recognise and avoid the common pitfalls associated with interpolation.
notes: Note — PHP on the Server: PHP-FPM / echo / variables / interpolation are the heart of this chapter. Read the sample, then type it yourself.
Good practice: keep every example short and runnable; add a comment that records the expected output exactly.

exercises.question: What is the purpose of PHP-FPM in PHP?
exercises.answer: PHP-FPM lets you interpolation — see chapter section 1.2.

exercises.answer: Avoid it when the task is better served by a simpler, linear approach — momentum matters more than cleverness.

tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes PHP-FPM behave that way? (PHP ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, Alio". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes strict_types behave that way? (PHP ch.2)
The worked sample prints "Type errors surface before runtime". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes arrow fn behave that way? (PHP ch.3)
The worked sample prints "[10.5, 21]". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes $_POST behave that way? (PHP ch.4)
The worked sample prints "User input rendered safely". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes PDO behave that way? (PHP ch.5)
The worked sample prints "Row inserted with binding safety". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes composer behave that way? (PHP ch.6)
The worked sample prints "Autoloaded class becomes available". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)

assessment.q: Write PHP code that reads a value, transforms it and prints the result. (final)
What does the score of 16.7 marks per chapter tell you about this exam's structure? (final)
